test_title: PYST 5: SSC JE EE- General Intelligence (Held On 10 Oct 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All goods are services.

Some services are applications.

All applications are forms.

**Conclusions:**

I. All goods can never be applications.

II. At least some services are forms.

III. No good is a form.
solution:
Statements:

All goods are services.

Some services are applications.

All applications are forms.

The Venn diagram as per the given statements:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb1c50aef672a799f21676fdfcfa1a8acb98ef77cc77fec69798ea3634808a32.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All goods can never be applications. → **Not follow** (Because all goods are services and some services are applications, so all goods can be applications is a possibility)

II. At least some services are forms. → **Follow** (Because some services are applications and all applications are forms, so at least some services are forms is definitely true)

III. No good is a form. → **Not follow **(There is no direct relation between good and form so it can be possible but not definitely true)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only II follows".**
